PRIVACY NOTICE

Marrowbone Fitness, Inc. operates the Marrowbone mobile application and the website at marrowbonefitness.com. This notice explains our privacy practices.

1. Information We Collect

We collect information about you, including your name, email address, payment information, location, and health and fitness information such as heart rate, weight, and body measurements. We also collect information automatically from your device.

2. How We Use Information

We use the information we collect to operate and improve the Services, to personalize your experience, to communicate with you, and for any other purpose we consider appropriate.

3. Sharing

We share information with our vendors, our advertising partners, and other third parties. We may sell or share your information with advertising partners so they can show you relevant offers.

4. Security

We use reasonable measures to protect your information.

5. Changes

We may change this notice at any time, and changes take effect when posted. Your continued use of the Services means you accept the change.

6. Contact

Questions? Email privacy@marrowbonefitness.com.
